title: CELEBRITY COLLECTION: Inside Kevin O'Leary's watch collection
hook: Mr. Wonderful's watches: which one would you take?
why: Owner wants celebrity collection posts like @nauvetimepieces (Reynolds/Zuckerberg). Kevin O'Leary is known for his watches; one trusted outlet naming them is enough (credit it).
